text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I stopped by the school store
together with Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! I thought I'd try folding some.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The other day, there was an origami cherry blossom inside a fan letter...
I could feel that person's feelings fill my entire heart.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So, I thought I'd fold some origami to give you in return!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just an ordinary Umamusume...
I don't possess anything vivid that would
captivate everyone's gaze."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... there are still people
cheering for me like this."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those words made me so happy...
and a little like crying, too.
...So warm... yet with a sharp, fiery heat.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I just feel like it's all a dream.
choice_data_list: So, what do you want to do, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I—
............
I want to live up to their expectations."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Gratitude to those who support me.
Joy to those who cheer for my running."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A smile blooming like a flower... That's what I want to deliver!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to become just like that origami—
a beautiful cherry blossom...!
choice_data_list: Well then, gotta return the favor first.
Well then, gotta return the favor first.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's why I'm planning to give her
an even bigger origami cherry blossom.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
To show my resolve—
that I'm going to bloom into a magnificent flower!
